title: 91 days to election: Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan) ready for year-round, people-centred representation
summary: With 91 days until the 16 January 2027 polls open in Yewa North/Imeko-Afon, NDC candidate Oluwadara Kehinde continues ward-level engagement. His agenda prioritises youth empowerment, agriculture and value addition, education and skills, accountable representation, and infrastructure and rural welfare so communities feel represented every day, not only at election time.

title: World Food Day 2026: Innovate today, nourish tomorrow — Oluwadara Kehinde prioritises agriculture
summary: On World Food Day (theme: Innovate Today, Nourish Tomorrow), Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan), NDC candidate for Yewa North/Imeko-Afon, renews his call for modern farming practices, value addition, reduced post-harvest losses and better opportunities for grassroots farmers so communities can feed themselves and thrive.

title: Kwankwaso: Peter Obi is giving Tinubu sleepless nights ahead of 2027
summary: NDC Vice-Presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso says Peter Obi’s popularity in the South and strong mobilisation in the North has the President concerned. The Obi-Kwankwaso ticket is described as a formidable team.

title: Kwankwaso: NDC will do whatever is necessary, including subsidy, to bring down fuel price
summary: On Politics Today, Kwankwaso confirmed that he, Peter Obi and NDC National Leader Seriake Dickson are aligned: energy prices are too high. The party will consider all options, including restoring fuel subsidy, to reduce the burden on Nigerians.

title: NDC to inaugurate Obi-Kwankwaso presidential campaign council on October 20
summary: NDC National Chairman announces October 20 NEC meeting to formally inaugurate the presidential campaign council for Peter Obi and Rabiu Kwankwaso, issue certificates of return, and strengthen structures. Local candidates like Oluwadara Kehinde are ready.

title: BBC Africa: Peter Obi on 2023 claims, NDC platform and fuel subsidy
summary: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi speaks to BBC Africa about the 2023 election, his current NDC platform, and his position on restoring fuel subsidy without the corruption that plagued the old system. Watch and share.
